name: John Varvatos
why: American rock-luxe — Detroit-born, leather-forward, the label that turned CBGB into a store; survived its 2020 restructuring with the register intact.
origin: John Varvatos, Detroit-raised, alumnus of Ralph Lauren and Calvin Klein (where he created the boxer brief), founded his label in 1999; opened a store inside the former CBGB at 315 Bowery in 2008.
opview: Rock and roll as the design brief — his stated north star.
